## Career Readiness

### Technical Profile & Market Positioning

-   **Comprehensive Skill Foundation:** Throughout my MSc, I have built a robust and diverse technical repertoire encompassing statistics, data science, machine learning, natural language processing, and advanced Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

-   **Strategic Market Entry:** While my academic breadth is extensive, I recognize that I am currently a generalist rather than an industry specialist. To bridge this gap and develop highly specific, industry-ready expertise, I am strategically targeting entry-level to lower-mid-level professional roles.

### Academic Pursuits & Professional Development

-   **Doctoral Application Experience:** I proactively submitted PhD applications throughout the academic year and successfully passed the rigorous departmental PhD interview. Although I was not nominated for funding this cycle due to limited availability and high competition, the process provided invaluable experience.

-   **Career Strategy & Networking:** To continuously refine my trajectory, I have engaged extensively with university career services to optimize my future PhD applications and enhance my networking strategies for the industry job hunt.
